answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 51434 Country: India Title: My daughter's name is Afia Ibnat. Is it correct according to our Shariat? Please tell me the Meaning of this name. Question: My daughter's name is Afia Ibnat. Is it correct according to our Shariat? Please tell me the Meaning of this name. Answer ID: 51434 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 582/471/B=04/1435) Afiya means: a woman who is protected against worldly problems and diseases, while Ibnat is not a meaningful word; therefore you should replace it with a suitable one. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
